programs.title: Disaster Autopsy: Compilation Season
programs.desc: Analysis of engineering tragedies on land, sea and space.Specialists will discuss the Columbia ferry accident, the Deepwater Horizon spill, the collapse of a shopping mall in Korea and the bridge in Genoa.

programs.title: Fatal Engineering
programs.desc: National Geographic inspires the explorer in everyone through breathtaking documentaries on science, history, and the natural wonders of our planet.

programs.title: Ice Road Rescue: Season 10
programs.desc: Further struggles for roadside assistance workers.During the harsh Norwegian winter, they help drivers in need.They also struggle with unfavorable conditions on communication routes.

programs.title: Air Crash Investigation
programs.desc: Behind the scenes of air accidents in recent years.Each episode will present a reconstruction of the events that led to the tragedy.The stories are supplemented by reports from experts and eyewitnesses.

programs.title: Life Below Zero: First Alaskans
programs.desc: A story about the indigenous people of Alaska who have lived according to the rhythm of nature for centuries.Each season has its own rules here.Tig Strassburg wants to give seven children the knowledge and skills to survive in this hostile place.Young Apassingoks hunt for the entire local community.Joel Jacko combines tradition with modernity.Jody Potts-Joseph, on the other hand, begins a new chapter of life in her home village.Marvin Agnot survives on what he catches in the ocean or finds on the coast.John and Teresa Pingayak are also training the next generation.
